occurrence_sentence: Story: MIT News, Image: MIT News/Shutterstock
MIT researchers report they have demonstrated a novel superconducting qubit architecture that can perform highly accurate operations between qubits.
The researchers utilized a relatively new type of superconducting qubit, known as fluxonium.

The architecture used by the MIT researchers involves a special coupling element between two fluxonium qubits that enables them to perform logical operations, known as gates, in a highly accurate manner.
The researchers implemented this architecture on a chip using an extensible fabrication process.
